reason: I already reorder Toplux when it runs out and I'm not looking to switch. Sachets also feel like extra foil packaging for something I can take from a bottle.
objection: Foil sachets for a daily thing is a lot of packaging waste, and I already have a supplement I stick with.
would_change_my_mind: If my current brand stopped working for me or got pricey, or if the sachet packaging were recyclable.
